system.description:
The raiding bands of the Red Waste and the Jotunas marches: ambush, speed and endurance.

  • Reshapes: Run Them Down is your Rage Style in place of Reckless.
  • Run Them Down: while raging, once per round, out of turn, when a foe you can see moves away from you, move up to half your speed after it; if you end beside it, attack it once.
    • 9th level: you move up to your full speed, and if that attack hits, the foe makes a Fortitude save against your Class Save DC or is knocked Prone.
  • Raider's Eye: Advantage on Survival checks in harsh terrain, and on checks to read tribal markings and the signs of a raid.
